games.name: TIMELESS
games.desc:
During a violent outbreak in Robloxia, an Agency has been created to keep the remaining survivors safe. Your mission is to team up with your fellow emissaries to investigate dangerous areas. But be careful, and use your skills to your advantage.

TIMELESS is a 1v8 asymmetrical horror game that revolves around general Roblox media. The game takes big inspiration from The Disaster by OutLaikRBLX, and Left 4 Dead.
WARNING: This game contains flashing/bright lights

[KEYBINDS]:

[PC]
-Q, F, R, T : Using Abilities
-Left Control : Toggle ShiftLock
-V : Toggle POV
-R : Revive
-C : Carry
-G : Emote
-X : Open/Close chat wheel

[CONTROLLER]
-Y, L1, R1, L3 : Using Abilities
-L2 : Sprinting
-DPadUp : Toggle ShiftLock
-B : Revive
-DPadRight : Carry
-DPadDown : Emote
-X : Open/Close chat wheel

(Keybinds can be edited in settings)

games.name: SCP: Site Roleplay
games.desc:
Hidden beneath the frozen tundra of Northern Canada lies SCP Foundation Containment Site-64, an ultra-classified facility controlled by an organization that studies and contains the supernatural. Site-64 operates at the brink of catastrophe at all times, facing constant escape attempts by dangerous anomalies, violent sabotage by Chaos Insurgents or Hostile Test Subjects, and a relentless scientific drive to research, even when doing so endangers the world.

Defend the facility as a Security, discover the unknown as a Scientist, endure dangerous experiments as a Class-D, or fight to dismantle the Foundation as an Insurgent or Hostile Test Subject. 

SECURE. CONTAIN. PROTECT.
